work_orders.title: U2 HI_JACKET_TEMP nuisance trips: suspect RTD or loose wiring

notes.text: 11/07: U2 tripped HI_JACKET_TEMP at 201F. Gauge looked normal by the time I got there. Reset and ran.
11/11: Same trip again. Reading jumps up and drops right back in 2-3 min, too fast for real jacket water. Probably the RTD.
11/14: Tripped twice today. Topped off U2 coolant (about 2 gal) while I was there. I&E scheduled Monday to replace the RTD and check wiring.
11/20 day shift: Per Rick, if U2 nuisance-trips tonight it's OK to bypass HI_JACKET_TEMP and keep it running. Watch the temp.

dispatch_jobs.reason: U2 HI_JACKET_TEMP trip at 16:28-ish (indicated 201.9F, jacket reading jumped 177->195->202->183 within ~3 min, discharge temp steady ~201F). Matches open WO-3402 suspected RTD/wiring fault. Need field verification of RTD/wiring per SOP-01 before/after restart. Icing conditions, arrival time expected to be long.

EMERGENCY/SAFETY: U2 gas LEL rising steadily since U2 stopped (1.6% -> 8.8% over ~12 min, ~0.6%/min) in engine package. U2 fuel valve closed and U2 suction/discharge blocks closed, but LEL still climbing. Suspected gas leak in U2 (packing, valve or piping). Need field check for leak source and gas detection. Also U2 HI_JACKET_TEMP sensor issue (WO-3402).
